name: Winter wheat
notes: FAO-56 T11 Mediterranean row (Nov, 240 d); T12 winter wheat non-frozen soils Kc_ini 0.7, Kc_end 0.25-0.4 (0.3 used); T22 root 1.5-1.8, p 0.55. Straw/stubble grazed.

name: Barley
notes: T11 Barley/Oats/Wheat 'Nov' row 40/60/60/40 (200 d, no region given); T12 Kc_mid 1.15, Kc_end 0.25, Kc_ini = cereal group 0.3 (image cell); T22. Grain + straw for livestock.

name: Oats
notes: Same FAO rows as barley; hay or grain.

name: Vetch-oat forage mix
notes: Not in FAO-56. Stages: barley Nov row, cut green at flowering (~160 d, late Apr-May) so short late stage; Kc legume group ini 0.4 / mid 1.15, end kept high (cut green); root/p from peas dry & chick pea. Vetch flowers + extrafloral nectaries = bee forage (to source).

name: Chickpea
notes: T12 Kc_mid 1.00, Kc_end 0.35, Kc_ini legume group 0.4; T22 root 0.6-1.0, p 0.50. Stages: no chickpea row found on the T11 page, lentil 'Oct/Nov arid region' row used (25/35/70/40). Also sown in spring (Feb-Mar) in Greece.

name: Lentil
notes: T11 Lentil Oct/Nov arid region 25/35/70/40 (170 d); T12 Kc_mid 1.10, Kc_end 0.30, Kc_ini legume group 0.4; T22 root 0.6-0.8, p 0.50.

name: Berseem clover (annual forage)
notes: T12 Clover hay Berseem averaged over cuttings 0.40/0.90/0.85; T22 root 0.6-0.9, p 0.50. Stages not in T11: autumn sowing, cuts Dec-May (team estimate). Bee value when let flower (to source).

name: Alfalfa (perennial forage)
notes: T12 Alfalfa hay averaged 0.40/0.95/0.90; T22 root 1.0-2.0, p 0.55; T11 total season = last -4 C in spring to first -4 C in fall (stage lengths here = one season approx). Stand 4-5 years. Bee value when cut late (to source).

name: Sainfoin (perennial forage)
notes: Not in FAO-56: alfalfa used as analog (deep-rooted perennial forage legume, drought tolerant). Excellent nectar plant (to source). Stand 3-4 years.

name: Phacelia (cover / bee crop)
notes: Not in FAO-56; short catch/cover crop sown after harvest with first autumn rain, flowers in ~6-8 weeks. Values are placeholders to replace with a source.

name: Maize (grain)
notes: T11 Maize grain April 'Spain (spr, sum.); Calif.' 30/40/50/30 (150 d); T12 Kc_mid 1.20, Kc_end 0.60-0.35 (0.35 dry harvest), Kc_ini cereal group 0.3; T22 root 1.0-1.7, p 0.55. Pollen only for bees.

name: Sunflower
notes: T11 Sunflower April/May Medit.; California 25/35/45/25 (130 d); T12 Kc_mid 1.0-1.15 (1.1 used), Kc_end 0.35, Kc_ini oil-crop group 0.35 (to check); T22 root 0.8-1.5, p 0.45.

name: Sorghum (grain)
notes: T11 Sorghum May/June 'USA, Pakis., Med.' 20/35/40/30 (130 d); T12 Kc_mid 1.00-1.10, Kc_end 0.55, Kc_ini cereal group 0.3; T22 root 1.0-2.0, p 0.55. Drought tolerant summer option.

name: Weedy fallow (grazed)
notes: Analog: FAO-56 T12/T22 'Grazing pasture, extensive grazing' 0.30/0.75/0.75, root 0.5-1.5, p 0.60. Volunteer weeds after autumn rain, grazed; cover is low until winter.

name: Grazing land (extensive)
notes: FAO-56 T12/T22 grazing pasture extensive grazing.

name: Olive grove
notes: FAO-56 T12/T22 olives 40-60 % ground cover. Context only (not in rotations).

name: Oregano / thyme strips
notes: Not in FAO-56; perennial aromatic strips on slopes (erosion barrier, bee forage, niche market). Placeholder values to replace with a source.
